content:
Best Buy 60th anniversary mega sale kicks off strong, with AirPods Pro 3 hitting their best price ever since launch, as low as 75% off retail; while AirPods Max 2 gets a further $120 price cut. In today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break, Amazon has also dropped AirTag 2 to a new historical low, Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro is reduced by up to $220, iPhone Air pricing returns to a low point, this 1TB M3 iPad Air drops $400 (saving a full $650 versus the M4 version), 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air gets $300 off via the official Apple Certified Refurbished store, plus several noteworthy headphone deals and more. Details below.

Best Buy 60th anniversary mega sale officially kicks off, aiming to challenge Black Friday! Deals on Apple, LG TVs, Android products, 10x rewards and more fully activated

Summer AirPods deals see further price drops, with savings of up to $120

After a round of discounts on Apple's latest AirPods lineup throughout the summer, essentially the entire range sees further price cuts today. The popular AirPods Pro 3 are selling at 75% off retail, one of the best prices; the AirPods 4 with active noise cancellation have dropped to a recent low; and AirPods Max 2 got an additional $120 off this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)

Amazon drops single AirTag 2 to $24, open-box $20 (as low as 30% off)

While you can still get the open-box version for $20 at Best Buy, Amazon now has the single AirTag 2 at $24, with free shipping for Prime members, matching the historical low we've tracked.

The 4-pack is of course an even better deal per unit, which has also dropped to an Amazon historical low of $89; but if you don't need four, the single pack is slightly cheaper.

Amazon now has the 2026 AirTag 2 single pack at $24, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (original price $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (original price $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 "Excellent Condition" open-box $20 (original new price $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (original price $99)

You can now buy an "Excellent Condition" AirTag open-box for $19.99 with shipping—equivalent to 69% off the $29 original new price.

Although Amazon's main deal today on the new unit is only 83% off retail, paying $4 more gets you a brand new sealed unit.

A discount on a $29 item doesn't seem dramatic, but a discount is still a discount, and this matches the best price we've tracked since Apple launched the new AirTag 2.

Amazon's highest quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro gets $220 off today (matching Prime Day pricing)

While the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store has always been my first choice for finding iPhone deals, Apple isn't currently selling the latest iPhone 17 Pro models there—it seems we'll have to wait until the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's highest quality Premium Renewed stock has returned to Prime Day pricing, with up to $220 off new retail prices.

Amazon's highest quality Premium Renewed models have always been the best way to get an unlocked iPhone 17 Pro. Besides saving hundreds of dollars, you also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and "greater than 90% original battery life"—compared to Amazon's non-"Premium" Renewed and Refurbished stock which only has a 90-day warranty and inferior battery condition.

You can now find 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models back in stock on Amazon, with discounts of up to $220—the 512GB version is $20 cheaper than last mentioned:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (original new price $1,299)

As mentioned in yesterday's Apple Refurb Store recommendation article, you can get a fully capable iPhone 16 starting from $699 with 1-year Apple warranty, and the 1TB 16 Pro Max is just $1,269—$330 cheaper than the similarly specced 17 Pro Max, and $130 cheaper than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 cheaper than the 17 series)

This 1TB M3 iPad Air drops $400 (saving $650 versus the M4 version)

While AirPods Pro 3 discounts continue to emerge, AirPods Max 2 gets $120 off, AirTag 2 returns to historical low, we also need to note the deep discount on iPad Air—$400 off (saving $650 versus the latest M4 version).

iPad Air series deals have been relatively scarce recently; although Amazon currently offers $100 off new retail prices, the M3 iPad Air discount from Best Buy during the 60th anniversary mega sale is more attractive.

The current price of the 1TB M4 iPad Air is $1,349, while new units on Amazon start from nearly $1,300.

Apart from the slightly faster M4 chip, the M3 version is essentially identical, which is more than enough for most users—Best Buy now has an 11-inch 1TB version at $699, saving $650 versus the M4 version's price:

  • 11-inch M3 iPad Air 1TB $699 (original price $1,099)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB from $1,292 (original price $1,349)

This 1TB M3 iPad Air is not only significantly cheaper than the closest M4 version, but also $50 below the 128GB model's price and $150 below the 512GB model's price.

If the M3 version's savings don't suit your needs, here are the best M4 version deals on Amazon:

M4 iPad Air 11-inch

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $650 (original price $749)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $749 (original price $849)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $949 (original price $1,049)

24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air gets $300 off new retail price via official Apple Refurb store

This morning we again checked the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store. Among the many choices well below original price, Apple has restocked the 15-inch 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air, with $300 off new retail price.

Apple now has the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB RAM and 1TB SSD priced at $1,699 with shipping. At time of writing, Silver, Starlight and Sky Blue are all available with this offer.

Stock like this usually sells out quickly, so act fast if interested.

This machine's new retail price is $1,999, the same whether at Apple, Amazon or other retailers. Today's offer lets you get this larger-screen high-end M5 MacBook Air configuration for $300 less.

For comparison, the same configuration on Amazon is still priced very close to full retail, with some models only dropping to around $1,925.

Amazon currently offers $100 off some M5 Air models, with certain Sky Blue versions getting $150 off, but since Apple raised prices across the entire MacBook and iPad lineup, deals close to $300 off have basically been unheard of—or rather, they did happen once.

The above discounts add to a series of noteworthy MacBook Pro deals and Apple discounts, combined with the full launch of Best Buy's 60th anniversary mega sale:

More of the best 60th anniversary deals this week:

Apple 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro with 96W adapter brand new $320 off

We continue to track the cheapest 16GB RAM M5 MacBook Pro at $320 off, and we've just discovered the 24GB/1TB version can save the same amount.

B&H now has the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB SSD priced at $1,899 with shipping.

Like the 16GB model, B&H's deal includes the upgraded 96W Apple charger—buying just this charger separately costs an extra $20.

In summary, a machine originally priced at $2,219 is now $1,899—today's discount of $320 off retail is the best price found on the market.

The 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro on Amazon starts at $2,049, and doesn't include the fast charger. Since the price hike hit retail, this configuration has never dropped to $1,899.

Also note the high-end M5 Pro models just restocked at the Apple Refurb Store with discounts:

  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,549 (original new price $2,999)
  • Space Black and Silver
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,059 (original new price $3,599)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,719 (original new price $3,199)

60th anniversary Apple mega sale officially kicks off: AirPods Pro 3 and Max 2 $120 off, AirTag 2 new low, iPhone Air $350 off, etc.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker 45W Nano smart display charger holds new low of $26, this bundle adds $4 for an extra USB-C cable
  • Spigen clear case gives M4 Mac mini retro iMac G3 style, hits new low of $25
  • Anker 2026 Back to School mega sale, chargers, power banks and Qi2.2 accessories return to Prime Day lows, from $10 (up to 54% off)
  • Anker 8-outlet power strip with USB and surge protection today $22
  • Anker eufy C31 indoor/outdoor security camera up to 33% off, 2-pack or Homebase bundle from new low of $40
  • Anker flat-plug 8-outlet power strip with USB now $24
  • Get Baseus 100W retractable USB-C cable with Apple Watch charging for $15 today (historical low)

AirPods Max 2 hits new low: 60th anniversary mega sale $120 off

Update: Amazon now also has the Midnight Black AirPods Max 2 bundle at special price $429—$120 off.

Combined with the AirPods Pro 3 at 75% off and AirPods 4 with active noise cancellation at their best price in 6 months, the summer discount on AirPods Max 2 is even more attractive. Both Amazon and Best Buy now have them $120 off, coinciding with the official launch of the 60th anniversary mega sale.

Best Buy officially launches 60th anniversary mega sale, loaded with Apple discounts, while Amazon is rapidly adjusting prices to compete.

You can now get the latest 2026 AirPods Max 2 headphones from Amazon and Best Buy at $429 with shipping—one of the best prices we've tracked.

At time of writing, all five colors are in stock at Best Buy for $429 with shipping; Amazon currently only has a few colors but should drop to this price across all colors soon.

For about a week prior we'd been tracking a steady $100 discount on the new Max 2, and now it's been further reduced, with a good chance of holding this price all week (provided Amazon and Best Buy don't run out of colors). Aside from the Prime Day limited $150 deal, this is the best price for this generation of Apple's over-ear AirPods since their earlier launch this year.

Unlocked iPhone Air returns to Black Friday pricing (saving nearly $160), open-box up to $350 off

Best Buy officially launches 60th anniversary mega sale, bringing unlocked, brand new iPhone Air back to Black Friday pricing.

During the 60th anniversary mega sale, Best Buy offers a significant $159 discount on all new unlocked iPhone Air models—the best price we've found from reputable sources:

  • iPhone Air 256GB $840 (original price $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB $1,040 (original price $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB $1,240 (original price $1,400)

We previously reported that Best Buy offered nearly $150 off all iPhone Air models during the July Black Friday event, but now the price has dropped further—this applies to all colors across the three storage options.

Although Amazon either undercut or matched Best Buy on most Apple products after this morning's sale launch, iPhone Air is exclusively dominated by Best Buy—Amazon doesn't officially sell new units at all.

If you want to get iPhone Air at a better price, check the "More options" "Excellent Condition" open-box next to each storage option on this Best Buy page—we've tracked savings of $350 or more.

  • Open-box iPhone Air 256GB Space Black $798 (original price $999)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Sky Blue $847 (original price $1,199)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Space Black $987 (original price $1,199)

Buy new MacBook Neo today and get $25 Starbucks gift card, or $120 off via Apple

Best Buy's 60th anniversary mega sale is in full swing, with thousands of price drops, 10x rewards for Plus/Total members and more rolling out. Besides discounts on AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Max 2 and AirTag 2, Best Buy is also offering MacBook Neo buyers a free $25 Starbucks gift card (or you can skip the gift card and get $120 off directly via the Apple Refurb Store).

During Best Buy's 60th anniversary mega sale, purchase MacBook Neo starting from $699 and you'll be treated to a few Starbucks coffees.

  • Buy MacBook Neo and get $25 Starbucks gift card

This isn't the real cash discount everyone expects, but considering Apple rarely offers discounts on new units of this cheapest current MacBook, if you're planning to buy one, grabbing a free Starbucks isn't bad.

That said, if you ask me, the best MacBook Neo discount online actually comes directly from Apple. Neo just got a $100 price hike, but you can head to the official Renewed Store for the best quality Refurb units in the city. Although there's no free coffee here, there are models from $599, and the 512GB version has up to $120 off:

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (original new price $699)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (original new price $799)

All these units come with:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare
  • Apple strict refurbishment process before shipping
